summary: Folded the newly registered source into the identity finding's account without rerunning anything: the claim that Ok(idx) is presented to callers as 'the submitted entry is decided at idx' now rests on the snapshot's own example text — the comment that the call exists for 'a specific entry whose durability the caller must confirm synchronously' and the line printing the resolved index as 'durably decided at log idx ... safe to announce' (examples/kv_store_async/src/main.rs:133-150) — alongside the handle documentation's 'await its decided log index' and the Superseded doc's own concession that an entry may never be decided. The corresponding limitation was rephrased to match what that evidence is (usage, not a formal guarantee; Entry is only Clone + Debug, so the actor cannot verify identity by value), and the rest of the account, its receipts and the other two limits are unchanged. Final position as the run's budget is exhausted: four findings stand — the actor layer's event egress parks the loop and, once enough nodes park, stops the cluster deciding (receipts ff4511e8, 76557a28, bbff5b4c; capacities 8/64/1024; corrected transport; 21.69s retrospective bound; superseded transport-jam run kept as an excluded cause); the core has no timer-driven repair for a lost Accepted reply, measured at two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses (receipts 092538c6, 9f3f25cc; one accounting question closed by explanation); append_notify can resolve Ok for an index occupied by another entry, bounded by measurement to entries the following leader did not adopt (receipts 743518e2, 78c53df3); and the actor layer owns the instance but offers no compaction path, with the panic-to-Shutdown attribution chain and the repository's compaction documentation as the norm (source-settled). The single declared unfinished measurement — the failure side of that last finding, a Storage whose write returns Err driven through the actor — remains unexecuted because it needs a delegating Storage wrapper that did not fit this turn's budget.
